name: Presto Ventures
legal_name: Presto Ventures II a.s., osoba rizikového kapitálu

entity_kind.quote: Since 2016, we’ve invested €40M from two funds. Our new €150M fund targets the best of security, defense, and aerospace tech, with focus on dual-use.

investor_type.quote: Venture kapitálové Presto Ventures patří mezi vůbec nejaktivnější startupové fondy u nás.

sectors.quote: Security, defense, and aerospace. Cutting-edge and dual-use solutions, both software and hardware, capable of solving the most pressing global challenges.

stages.quote: Mostly post-revenue companies raising a €800k to €8M financing round, looking to accelerate their growth. Tickets ranging from €500k to €5M.

aum.quote: Since 2016, we’ve invested €40M from two funds. Our new €150M fund targets the best of security, defense, and aerospace tech, with focus on dual-use.

investments.quote: které vedl fond český Presto Tech Horizons, jejž založila společnost Presto Ventures a zbrojařská skupina CSG miliardáře Michala Strnada. K fondu se připojily i další mezinárodní investoři jako Antler, Freedom Fund a TYR.vc. Kapitál Occam využije k urychlení adopce své technologie napříč ukrajinskou frontou

Americko-maďarský startup DiffuseDrive z oblasti tzv. fyzické umělé inteligence dokáže takový fotorealistický obsah vytvářet v řádu hodin. To zaujalo mimo jiné i české investory – fond Presto Tech Horizons společně s americkým Outlanderem vedly seed investici ve výši 3,5 milionu dolarů, v přepočtu 78 milionů korun.
Zerops, a Prague-based developer of a cloud platform that builds, deploys, and manages apps, has raised $500,000 in a pre-Seed investment round backed by Presto Ventures and Gi21 Capital.

notes: Prague VC (formerly Bohemia Venture Capital); new fund Presto Tech Horizons is a JV with CSG (4 bn CZK / €150M), focus on defense/dual-use. AUM is the new fund size. Founder Přemysl Rubeš left (cooperation ended Sept 2025, detained by police March 2026, not business-related per press). No verified Slovak deal; SK in active_in based on Czech-Slovak portfolio company Sloneek (Presto invested in 2022 per CzechCrunch, 2024-09-10) — uncertain.
